channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Writers, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Writers, Australia, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
3 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 06 Jul 2026 (06 Jul to 12 Jul 2026).

  • Create NSW: Stories Matter NSW Literary Fellowships 2026
    Create NSW (administered by Writing NSW) · deadline Closed 27 Jul 2026 · AUD 50,000 per fellowship, 10 fellowships awarded (4 emerging, 3 mid-career, 3 established). No application fee.
  • Copyright Agency Cultural Fund: Fellowship for Non-Fiction Writing 2026
    Copyright Agency (Cultural Fund) · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · AUD 80,000 (one fellowship). No application fee.
  • Copyright Agency Cultural Fund: Author Fellowship 2026
    Copyright Agency (Cultural Fund) · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · AUD 80,000 (one fellowship). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
